figurative_meaning_en: Various troubles; times of misfortune and danger
example_sentences_in_bangla: জীবনে আপদ-বিপদ অনেক আসে, কিন্তু ধৈর্য ধরতে হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: True friends are known in times of calamity and danger.
Life brings many misfortunes and troubles, but one must remain patient.
note: Often used to emphasize loyalty and support during hardships in Bengali culture.
